en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a row of historic gabled houses along a narrow street. The buildings have stepped and ornate Flemish façades with tiled roofs and tall, narrow windows. Some façades display signage above the ground‑floor doors and windows, and there are flagpoles mounted on the fronts of the houses. Printed caption text in French appears at the top left, and small red printer's marks are visible at the lower left margin.
